print("First 5 revenue values (as string):", sales['revenue'].head().tolist())

print("Unique values in status:", sales['status'].unique())

# Show the unique values in channel
print("Unique values in channel:", sales['channel'].unique())

# Show the unique values in customer_segment
print("Unique values in customer_segment:", sales['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for the 999999.99 sentinel in revenue
print("Number of 999999.99 in revenue:", (sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
